items.question: How long does an online order take?
Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?
items.answer: Yes. Any pizza can be made on a gluten-free base (+$5) or with dairy-free cheese (+$3). Vegetarian pizzas are marked V on the menu.

items.question: Can you cater my event?
items.answer: Not from the truck. For events, contact [Basilico Pizza Catering](https://basilicopizzacatering.com.au).
